title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I dunno, maybe. Plus my wife won't let me inside because the baby's got chicken pox.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Really? Do you mind if I bring my boys over so she can infect Rod and Todd? Then there'll be a pox on both our houses!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Why would you do that? Are you a bad parent?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Au contraire, man with no hair! You see, Rod and Todd can only get the chicken pox once, and childhood's the safest time!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: So you want Maggie to infect your kids?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: You betcha! In fact, some parents have been known to hold "pox parties," so other kids in the neighborhood can get the disease when they please.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: And would they pay handsomely for the privilege?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Uh, hi. Luann'll pick Milhouse up when the party's over. I'll just read in the car till then.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: ...normally I'm not one to laugh at a man's urinary blockage, but, you shoulda seen it... oh, there he is.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I feel like a chicken already. I just made an egg in my pants!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Hey Marge. Hit me with a little more of that silly slush.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Chief, don't you think you've had enough?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I'm fine. Watch, I can even touch my gun to my nose.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Oh don't worry, I'm the Pief of Cholice. I mean I'm uh, beef with no cheese. Why doesn't Lou like me? Why?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Knock, knock!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Luann, what are you doing here?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I thought you were just dropping Milhouse off. I could get some coffee and come back...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: No, no, no, you stay. I'll just drive home. Uh, who's gonna let me siphon?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Look, why don't you both stay and have one of my Marge-aritas?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: All right!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I never drank one of these without a cigarette in it!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Now kids, in lieu of one of those inflatable jumping things, please welcome Mr. Krusty the Clown!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Hey, hey, kids! This putz only paid for twenty seconds, so listen fast. Moishe caught the chicken pox, he scratched all night and day / He asked the rabbi what to do, and he said Time! I'm outta here!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Kirk, you look good. Have you been working out?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Well, dogs have been chasing me...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: No one's been chasing me lately.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: What happened to your last boyfriend? The one who'd always go to the gym after visiting you, then have lunch at that place downtown? You know his taillight's broken.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I'm not seeing him anymore.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Well, does that mean there might be a chance for me?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Almost anyone's got a chance now.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: You think that's traumatic.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Mr. Stomach, are you hungry? I'm always hungry. Now make with the pizza, Fatso. You're the stomach!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Oh, Mr. Van Houten, I love when you kiss me! Yeah, yeah, kissing ladies is the best. Oh baby, kiss my mouth. Kiss me like we're in a fancy hotel.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: All right, we get it!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Marge, what's happening to me?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Oh Homie, you got chicken pox. But how?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I don't know. I kept away from Maggie all day.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I'm so itchy!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Oh yeah.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Son, we want to talk about what you saw in the Simpsons' house.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Well, I didn't see anything to get my hopes up, if that's what you mean.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Well, maybe you should get your hopes up a little.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: They're already up! They're sky-high!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Your father and I are going through what's called a "trial un-separation."

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: And son, I wanna make one thing clear. Unlike the breakup, this is not your fault.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I can't believe it! Our family might get back together again!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I haven't daydreamed in color in so long.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Oh, thank God. We were afraid we lost you, son.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: You sit in this oatmeal awhile, and it'll send your itchies packing! Homer!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Mmm... Homer-oats.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Stop eating the oatmeal! That's the third tub you've eaten!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Y'ello? No, I'm not coming into work. I have chicken pox. I know I said that last month, but I was lying.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Right... right... right... right... okay... right. I love you, bye!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I just got fired. Better check the "Want Ads."

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Ooh! "Truck drivers needed in Iraq."

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Trucks are like big cars.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Okay, Luann. For honesty's sake, we should probably talk about everyone we dated while we were separated.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Well, the Sea Captain and I...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Yeah, okay, I don't wanna know! I don't wanna know! I don't wanna know!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: So what are we going to do as a family today? Mini-golf? Pedal boats? Indoor rock wall?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Um, Milly...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Botanical garden? Build-A-Bear Workshop? Arena Football with the Springfield Stun?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Not today, big guy. Your Dad and I need more time to get... reacquainted.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Why are you laughing? Tell me! Private jokes are rude.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Uh son, here's ten bucks. Why don't you go to the bowling alley and throw some solo balls?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: But it's league night!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: This trial un-separation stinks. My parents used to compete for my love, and I cashed in every time.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: And I always got the spillover. Drive-in movies, two Christmases, soda with dinner -- we lived like kings!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Remember when you told my Dad to go to bed and he did?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: That was some New Years. Now listen. I think we should consider breaking your parents up again.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I don't know, Bart. I've wanted them back together for so long.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Look, you know they're gonna separate again. So why don't we just speed up the process?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: You know, Bart, my imaginary friend never made me do things I thought were wrong.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: That's why he had to go away forever.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I thought you were gonna let him come back!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I'm afraid he has to spend another year searching for his brain.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Luann, I'm moving my stuff back in!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Uh, Dad... Mom says you're stinky and gross.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Your mother said that?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: This is so great! I mean, she used to keep her criticisms all bottled up... until they destroyed our marriage. And I guess I am a little funky. Well, this is what cologne samples are for!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Mom, I don't wanna get Dad in trouble... but he just let me drink a beer.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Hm. Looks like we have a problem here.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: The problem being that you are addicted to fibbing.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I am drunk -- I'll prove it! Watch me... kiss this picture of Nana.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I can't do it. She's so mean to me. She wouldn't let me eat Fruit Loops!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Maybe my Mom and Dad are meant to be together, Bart.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: You'd better hope not, 'cause you know what comes next? Your worst nightmare: a baby sister.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Hi, Bart. I baked you some cookies.

spoken_words: Skanks for nothing, Lamerella.

spoken_words: If you two don't mind, I'd like to watch that cool Fox show about teenagers in Orange County.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Does this, or does this not, belong to Feather?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Sorry, Jade. That's how we light it up in the O.C.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: You cheated on me! Our mixed-race fling is so over!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Whatever. Let's score some jam at Knott's Berry Farm.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: For sure, dog. We'll be kickin' it old-school at Bigfoot Rapids.

spoken_words: I bet that bra was planted by Sterling, to break them up.

spoken_words: That's a brilliant idea. Those TV writers are geniuses!

spoken_words: Milhouse! I need slender fingers to get me a pickle!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: This isn't mine.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I have a message for your wife: stop sleeping with my husband!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Okey-doke. And you are...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: The wife of your wife's lover!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Will she know what this is regarding?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: You moron! Marge is having an affair with Kirk!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: That's ridiculous! No woman would want to have sex with that loser! And, uh, congratulations on snagging him back. Good stuff.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Never mind about those two. Just answer me one question. How did your wife's bra end up in my husband's bed?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: This-this is Marge's bra. I bought it for her boobs!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Of all the people for Marge to cheat on, why did it have to be me?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Oh boy, am I beat! If you wanna return a melon to the grocery store, clear your day!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I repeat: did you sleep with Kirk?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Homer, you're crazy!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: You're not saying no.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Fine... No!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: No, no, no!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Well, methinks the lady doth protest too much!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: You don't trust me? After I salved every chicken pock on your ungrateful body! How dare you!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Get out of this house!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Gladly.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: We tried to break up your parents and we broke up mine!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Well, I'd better go.

spoken_words: Where are you staying?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Bart, I think you're behind this whole thing.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Yeah, I can see how you'd think that. But on the other hand...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I can read you like a book.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Ha, ha, you read books.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: If you don't tell Mom what you did, I will.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Oh come on, wouldn't it be easier if our parents divorced and you compensated by marrying much older men? Meanwhile, I'll be one of those weird guys who's thirty-five and shows up at high school basketball games.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Why did I marry that selfish jerk? I've asked him to flip the mattress a thousand times, and he never does!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Uh, Mom?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Hi, sweetie.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Uh... you know that bra that broke up our family?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Uh-hmm.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Well, I looked into it, and it turns out I was responsible.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Really? Well, just for that I'm gonna erase all the saved games on your PlayStation.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: What?! How do you know about things like that?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: I learned about it in here.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: But now Dad can come home, right?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: No.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: But he's innocent.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Innocent?! After all I do for your father, he still doesn't trust me. I'm finished with him.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Does this mean you and Dad might get a D-A-V-U-R-S?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Young man, you go work on your spelling... or I'll delete all the custom ring tones from your cell phone!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Nooo!!!!!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Milhouse, our reverse parent trap just made everything worse.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Maybe we should use a different movie as our guide. Like "Oklahoma."

spoken_words: No!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Okay. When Mom and Dad see this dummy fall in the river, they'll think it's me, and they'll realize what really matters: each other.

spoken_words: Where's my apology?

spoken_words: Where's my bucket?

spoken_words: Mom, Dad! I'm playing on a dangerous cliff -- because you're too busy arguing to pay attention to me!

spoken_words: Bart! We're all disappointed there's no potato salad! But for God's sake, don't jump!

spoken_words: Okay.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: We'll lose the first kajillion to taxes.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Well, I guess you showed you do trust me after all.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Oh, Homie...

spoken_words: I don't want to live in a world without Bart!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
spoken_words: Can he swim?
